newsitem.title: GREECE: Princess Diana arrives in Greece for funeral.
newsitem.headline: Princess Diana arrives in Greece for funeral.

text.p: Britain's Princess Diana arrived in Greece on Wednesday to attend the funeral of a young man she met during one of her mercy visits to a London hospital, official sources said.
Diana, dressed in black and wearing a necklace of white pearls, landed at Athens airport and left quickly by car for the funeral in the mining town of Limni on the island of Evia.

One of Greece's largest islands, Evia is northeast of Athens and linked to the mainland by a bridge. Diana made no comment to reporters and kept her head bowed most of the time, avoiding a direct look into television cameras.
She will attend the funeral of Yannis Kalyviotis, 27, who died in a London hospital at the weekend.

Diana met Kalyviotis on one of her regular visits to London hospitals and took an interest in his case, the sources said. He died in London at the weekend of cystic fibrosis, a non-contagious, hereditary disease.
Diana divorced Prince Charles, heir to the British throne, this year. She is due to attend a gala dinner next Tuesday in Washington.
